article.title_en: Health Essential Association CPMM: food pantry in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: Health Essential Association CPMM es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Atiende los jueves de 10am a 12pm, con despensa el primer y tercer jueves del mes.
article.summary_en: Health Essential Association CPMM is a food pantry in Brooklyn listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open Thursdays from 10am to 12pm, with the pantry on the 1st and 3rd Thursdays.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 2336 86th St, Brooklyn, NY 11214.
Abre los jueves de 10am a 12pm; la despensa es el primer y tercer jueves.
Puede llamar al (646) 515-6898 para preguntar antes de ir.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si pide algún requisito.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 2336 86th St, Brooklyn, NY 11214.
It is open Thursdays 10am-12pm; the pantry runs on the 1st and 3rd Thursdays.
You can call (646) 515-6898 to ask questions before going.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are any requirements.
visit_tips_es: Planee su visita para el primer o tercer jueves del mes, entre 10am y 12pm.
Llame al (646) 515-6898 antes de ir para confirmar los detalles.
Pregunte por teléfono qué alimentos ofrece y si necesita llevar algo.
visit_tips_en: Plan your visit for the 1st or 3rd Thursday of the month, between 10am and 12pm.
Call (646) 515-6898 before going to confirm the details.
Ask by phone what food is offered and if you need to bring anything.
